cohort: 100 moderate and late preterm neonates delivered or admitted within seven days of life in a tertiary level neonatal care unit.
finding: Cranial abnormalities were noted in 26% of neonates, with intraventricular hemorrhage grade 1 or 2 being the most common abnormality.
followup_time: up to 40 days of life (second cranial ultrasound performed between 3 and 40 days of life)
